source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Chapter 6 6 + Chapter 7 4
claim_en: THE HEAT-SOURCE CLASSIFIER. Fire-caused = burn; all else (Tiberias springs included) = boil; the pre-Speaking boil counts.
middah: M-09 (fire-caused is a burn, all else a boil — the text's own rule for its two words; the pre-Speaking boil counts)

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Chapter 6 5; 7 + Section 4 1-2 + Chapter 7 3
claim_en: THE CRUST AND PRECEDENCE. Garlic-peel crust defines both; boil precedes the mark; the transmitted quarantine held without its reason, the reason later found.
middah: plain (the garlic-peel crust defines both; boil precedes the mark; the transmitted quarantine held without its reason)

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Section 4 4-5 + Chapter 7 1-2
claim_en: REGION-SCOPED SPREAD. The mark spreads only inside its own region; the two-hair thread; boil and burn never combine.
middah: E2 ('in the boil' — the mark spreads only inside its own region; the two-hair thread; boil and burn never combine)

claim_en: THE DOUBT POLARITY. Spread-doubt pure both directions (with R. Akiva's arm); each sign its own default; late spread counts; the retro-returns.
middah: plain (the doubt polarity — spread-doubt pure both ways with R. Akiva's arm; each sign its own default; late spread counts)

claim_en: THE TOKEN ACCOUNTING. Three tzaraat-tokens and three it-tokens, each with an assigned job — the chapter audited by its own repetitions.
middah: E10 (three leprosy-tokens and three it-tokens, each assigned a job — the chapter audited by its own repetitions)
